model_meta.description: Inferred system model of a feeder that separately transfers longitudinal bars from a storage/delivery mechanism into rotating, helical transport spaces.

subsystems.description: Stores longitudinal bars and delivers them toward a release edge, including a delivery chute in a disclosed embodiment.

parts.description: Chute terminating at a release edge; disclosed delivery variants include tilting, pushers, or manual movement.

subsystems.description: At least two rotatably mounted rods carry helical structures defining separated bar spaces and abutment means that gate bar entry as the unit rotates.

parts.description: Parallel, rotatably mounted rods with helical outer structures defining separated spaces; claim 3 specifies at least two.
Screw-like wall structures or helical grooves that define bar-accommodating spaces.
Radially extending abutment screw sections; separating edge may cut between successive bars.

subsystems.description: Controls rotation of at least two rods so their abutment means have equal rotational position relative to the release edge.
Downstream recipient to which individually transported bars may be fed.

item_flows.name: Longitudinal bars delivered to release edge
item_flows.notes: Bars move from storage/delivery mechanism toward the transport unit.

item_flows.name: Individually transported longitudinal bars
item_flows.notes: Bars are carried in separated spaces toward further processing.

steps.description: Move a stored bar toward the delivery mechanism release edge.
Deliver the bar toward the transport unit; a disclosed chute may terminate at the release edge.
Rotation positions the abutment section to allow a bar to enter a space in front of the abutment means while blocking entry into spaces behind it.
The rotating helical structure moves the admitted bar in the transport direction in a separated space.
The separating edge may pass between a first and second bar, acting as a stopper or separator for the second bar.
Control rotation of at least two rods so their abutment means occupy equal rotational positions relative to the release edge.
